dataset.unit: exact product variant/revision group; conservative brand/family split blocking

referenceGrades.1: independent original-image transcription by two actual readers and distinct adjudication; provenance-backed
referenceGrades.2: owner/developer visually verified literal declarations with original coordinates; not independent
referenceGrades.3: model-assisted or external database candidate; agreement only

dataset.unscorable: Unreadable, absent or unverified declaration; never zero
dataset.splitPolicy: Connected components of every declared brand alias and family identifier; all known exposed components remain development. Development takes precedence over calibration, then prospective held-out. Actual family/exposure/variant review and split lock pending.
dataset.photoClasses: original source file does not prove camera photograph or readability; photograph/render and difficult-layout strata require human review

knownDevelopmentBrands.basis: existing owner-visible development histories and original intake; conservative exposure blocking, not scientific/intent classification

reconstruction.primaryEndpoint: existing exact complete nutrient/value/qualifier/unit/basis/column association precision/recall, with clear-field denominators
reconstruction.aggregation: per-product first; macro mean over identical completed/scorable product intersection across methods; separately report all attempted failures, omissions, unscorable cells and partial subsets
reconstruction.noAccuracyFrom: OCR character volume, database agreement, software tests or candidate references
reconstruction.structure: Pinned upstream GriTS content/topology/location only for explicit independently annotated/predicted grids; location unavailable when no genuine cell geometry
reconstruction.text: one-to-one literal category/text/code matches; ingredient sequence exactness; semantic paraphrases require separate human adjudication

conversation.candidateContexts: three retained exposed actual application package snapshots, Grade 3, schema/hash checked; exact package facts not independently established
conversation.extensionScope: separate evaluation-only transfer/adversarial suite, not silently added to original denominators

ratingScale.4: correct, relevant, complete for question, evidence-calibrated
ratingScale.null: not applicable with reason, or unfilled pending; never substitute a model opinion

conversation.atomicClaimPolicy: separate package, calculation, scientific and interpretation claims; quote actual displayed response; supplied support verdicts with source IDs and rationale; segregate human/developer/AI-assisted judgments
conversation.toolPolicy: evaluate eligible/offered, selected arguments, execution status, returned evidence, applicability, synthesis, validation and display separately; valid alternative plans and relevant evidence reuse allowed; no forced lookup per health word

labels.1: topically related but insufficient to answer
labels.3: directly useful for the question with applicable scope

retrieval.judgmentPool: blind union of retrieval conditions plus predeclared relevant candidates; randomized source ordering; include negatives; incomplete pool => metrics null

statistics.samplingUnit: product group, not photograph/field/turn treated as independent person
statistics.report: raw numerator/denominator plus per-product/per-conversation results; do not pool reference grades, assessor types, code/model versions
statistics.pairedUncertainty: Report raw paired differences. Any later resampling must cluster related product groups/brand blocks and be predeclared; no intervals generated in preparation.
statistics.multipleComparisons: exploratory unless preregistered; no superiority claim from isolated pilot

performance.cost: actual returned usage and dated price estimate; billed unknown stays null; no double-counting overlapping total/output/thinking; free/paid separated
performance.failures: retain timeout, unavailable, adapter/schema rejection, withholding, fallback and retries; changed model/config => noncomparable; never silently drop failed arms

executionFreeze.status: BLOCKED_BY_DESIGN; next owner mission authorizes execution
